title: ALMA view of a massive spheroid progenitor: a compact rotating core of molecular gas in an AGN host at z = 2.226
question: What are the size, gas content, ISM conditions and kinematics of the dust and molecular gas in GMASS 0953, a proposed progenitor of compact quiescent galaxies?

what.value: Archival ALMA band 3 data and CO(3-2), CO(4-3), [CI] results, dust mass/temperature consistency

evidence.quote: We also combined our band 3 continuum data with those from (cite: popping2017) taken from the ALMA archive

what.value: Photometric and kinematic Halpha PAs and rotation curve

evidence.quote: This value is consistent with both the photometric and kinematic H$\alpha$ PAs as determined by HST imaging and KMOS data

recipe.method: Interactive clean with Briggs weighting; moment 0 over -1000 to 1000 km/s
Extrapolate CO(1-0) from CO(3-2) using average BzK and ULIRG SLEDs, then L'CO and alpha_CO

recipe.goal: Constrain ISM density and radiation field
recipe.method: Grid of 1-D slab PDR models compared to [CI]/CO(6-5) and CO(6-5)/CO(4-3) ratios
3D tilted-ring model, two rings of 0.2 arcsec, PA fixed at 95 deg, free Vrot and sigma, inclination varied
assumptions: Inclination range 60-90 deg from residual maps

not_stated_but_needed: Exact BAROLO settings (mask, normalization, fit mode)
CLOUDY grid ranges and cosmic-ray scaling
Which CO SLED templates and flux ratios were used
score_reason: Public data and main steps described, but many parameters missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (size, flux, Vrot) with a reasonably described recipe.
